0022600117.text: The 76ers (3-0, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) host the Detroit Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central, 1st in the East) in Philadelphia's fourth game of the season, with the 76ers on a three-game winning streak and a 2-0 home record. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain), and Jabari Walker (knee), Joel Embiid (rest), and LeBron James (back) are listed as day-to-day. Detroit is missing Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Ausar Thompson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain, while the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after the 76ers lost 0-4 to the Pistons in 2025-26, most recently 116-93 in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
